calls.title: Tangence - Growthbook Follow up
calls.summary: The meeting focused on outlining a flexible three-month pilot project at a base tier of $3,500 per month, allowing for diverse project testing in response to changing industry needs. Manish Mehta proposed using available resources flexibly, while Ashley plans to align stakeholders before finalizing the project list. The discussion highlighted an emphasis on content amplification—transforming existing assets into formats like infographics and videos, responding to rising client demands. The follow-up meeting is scheduled for June 1 after Ashley's vacation to finalize the pilot scope and priorities. Clear communication protocols were established to ensure continued support and clarity during the pilot phase, while informal rapport was built to enhance trust and collaboration.
calls.keywords: content amplification, pilot project, creative support, video production, project plan, three-month engagement
calls.action_items:
**Ashley**
Develop and prepare a project plan with a prioritized list of potential pilot projects for Tangence support, using a backlog approach and remaining open to new ideas during the pilot period (06:11)
Confirm the project plan and pilot scope with the Growthbook team before the follow-up meeting (06:31)
Attend the follow-up meeting scheduled for June 1st at 12:30 pm to discuss the project plan and pilot program details (06:46)

**Manish Mehta**
Arrange and send a calendar placeholder for the June 1st at 12:30 pm follow-up meeting (06:53)
Provide ongoing support and additional information about Tangence’s services as needed prior to the next meeting (06:58)
